name: I don't understand fills the prompt

pr.title: Fill the prompt when you press I don't understand
pr.head: a1a4a0a5e0429369e5b197f5667dc6f0fedd7f30

summary: Projector's panel lists the items agents post to your inbox: questions, notices, and requests. Each item opens a drawer of actions. One of them, I don't understand (hotkey 6), tells the agent that posted the item to rewrite it more simply. Before this change, one press ran project inbox unclear at once and sent the agent the line UNCLEAR <number> <subject>. You had no way to say what you didn't follow.

Now the press works like Discuss: it only fills the prompt with the quoted item, a blank line, and I don't understand , and you finish the sentence. When you send the prompt, the panel's prompt.submit hook recognizes the words under the quote. It adds a note for the main loop that starts with the UNCLEAR line, and once the prompt has entered, it records project inbox unclear and marks the line delivered, so the agent hears it once.

• Proposal. What a drawer put in the prompt, kept so a sent quote goes to the item you acted on. A press of I don't understand now records one, with the detail you read.
  • Stale. A proposal made before its item was revised. A stale press should add no note and mark nothing.
  • Main loop. The conversation you type into, as opposed to a subagent that posted the item.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
The first Projector review, of 21e1cc0, opened three findings. Three commits answer them, and the review of a1a4a0a is clean, with all three verified at that head:

  • A press made before a revision now says nothing when sent. That holds when only the subject changed, and when the panel had not yet read the revision, because the prompt hook now reads the store first.
  • Typed I don't understand goes to the item whose drawer put the quote in the prompt, through Discuss or an option.
  • docs/cli.md, the tool descriptions, and two comments now say that UNCLEAR goes out when you send the filled prompt.

One suggestion is left: prefer the drawer you acted in last over an older, abandoned press.

groups.title: Reading I don't understand in a sent prompt
groups.kicker: How readPrompt recognizes the words under a quote and which item they go to
intro: readPrompt reads each prompt you send against the open items. Before this change it found answers, request outcomes, and replies. It now also returns unclears: the items a quote followed by I don't understand speaks to. The words must start the text under the quote, with either apostrophe, and an option whose text is those words still answers.

The words go to the item whose drawer last put the quote in the prompt. A press of I don't understand comes first, then any other drawer, through Discuss or an option. That item takes the words only while what you read there still stands: the press is not stale, and the item's quote and detail are unchanged. Otherwise the quote replies as before, and the words never fall through to another item. Only a quote that no drawer put in the prompt goes to the oldest item with that text. unclearNote writes the note the main loop reads, and names the subagent to pass it to when one posted the item.

checks.text: Items of every kind can be marked unclear, notices included, while only questions and requests take answers and replies. That is why the new code keeps a separate markable list beside open.

files.note: Adds UNCLEAR_WORDS, unclearOf, mayBeUnclear, the unclears result of readPrompt, a detail on Proposal, and unclearNote, and rewords unclearArrives for the tool descriptions.

checks.text: A probe test pressed 6, then rewrote only the subject in the store and advanced one tick. Sending the old fill then added no note and ran no project inbox unclear.
With two "Merge it?" questions and a Discuss on the newer one, a probe found that typed I don't understand why now marks the newer one.

A press of I don't understand wins over any other drawer, even one you acted in later. So an abandoned press on the older of two same-subject items beats a later Discuss on the newer one. The review lists this as a suggestion.

files.note: Adds the unclears: [] field to existing expectations, and new tests for what a press fills, how the words are read, which item they go to, a subject-only revision, and the note's wording.

groups.title: The panel's press and the prompt hook
groups.kicker: The press fills the prompt; sending it records and delivers once
intro: The drawer's I don't understand button now calls propose and fill, like Discuss, instead of act, which no longer takes unclear. The hotkey, the fallback for a stored item whose choice holds 6, and the keyboard ring are unchanged.

In prompt.submit, a prompt that holds the words first reads the store, so that a revision since the last tick counts. Then each item in unclears adds an unclearNote to the prompt's context and closes its drawer. Once the prompt has entered, the hook runs recordFromPrompt with unclear, --subject, and --detail. recordFromPrompt holds the item in delivering and marks the line delivered, so the panel's own deliverer never sends it a second time.

checks.text: A probe test sent the filled prompt twice for a running subagent's question. project inbox unclear ran once, the panel sent the subagent nothing itself, and the second prompt only replied.

files.note: Moves I don't understand from an immediate act call to a prompt fill, and records it from prompt.submit.

checks.text: A probe test pressed 6, rewrote the detail in the store, and sent the prompt before the next tick. The prompt carried no note, and no mark was attempted.

files.note: Rewrites the I don't understand tests for the fill-then-send flow: a running subagent's notice, a prompt sent as filled, a terminal unclear that cannot be delivered, a dropped prompt, and a press made before a revision. Adds a test for a subject-only revision and for a revision the panel has yet to read.
Rewords the unclear field's comment: you send the filled prompt, or run project inbox unclear.

groups.title: Documentation
intro: docs/plugins.md now says the press fills the prompt, shows an example, and describes the note, the record, the stale case, and which item typed words speak to when two items share a subject. It keeps a separate paragraph for project inbox unclear run from a terminal, which the panel still delivers. docs/cli.md's unclear section now describes the same press. The completed inbox/unclear plan stays as the record of what that project shipped.

files.note: Rewrites the I don't understand paragraph and the lines about hotkey 6 and the keyboard ring.
Says the panel's press fills the prompt, and that unclear runs once you send it.
